title: SEC EDGAR (filings and XBRL financial facts)
covers: reported financials with their exact period (start, end, fiscal year, fiscal period, form, filing date)
company identifiers (CIK, ticker, fiscal year end)
query_style: Needs a CIK or ticker named in the question; never guessed. Ask for one concept (revenue, net income) and the fiscal year or period.
weak_at: companies outside the US filing system
time_behavior: Every fact carries its own period and filing date. Fiscal years differ by company (Apple ends in September, Microsoft in June).
limits: Declared contact in the User-Agent and a shared request budget (see docs/api-usage-rules.md). No crawling of sec.gov.
route_when: \b(10-?K|10-?Q|8-?K|SEC|EDGAR|CIK|filings?|filed|fiscal|revenues?|net sales|net income|earnings|EPS|shares outstanding|balance sheet|annual report|quarterly report|total assets|ticker)\b
